فُلْجٌ (S, O, K) and ↓ فَلَجٌ (L) and ↓ فُلْجَةٌ , (O, K,) substs., (or, accord. to some, the first and second are inf. ns., TA,) Success; success in an enterprise or a contest; conquest; or victory. (S, O, L, K.) One says, لِمَنَ الفُلْجُ and ↓ الفَلَجُ To whom belongs success, or the conquest, or victory? (Lh, L.) ―
-b2- See also فَلْجٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
